name: Grim's Gambit
source:
Embark on a captivating journey with "Grim's Gambit," an intricately crafted interactive puzzle visual novel that immerses you in the role of our main character named Nox. A character entangled in the disruption of the natural order, now standing trial for their alleged crimes. The storyline takes a daring turn, offering a unique twist to the traditional trial by sentencing Nox to a fate that is both unexpected and hauntingly bizarre. Nox's punishment unfolds in the haunting ambiance of a peculiar coffee shop, situated amidst the desolate realm of the Stygian Keep. Nox wakes with amnesia, gradually piecing together his forgotten past throughout the game. As players guide him through the puzzle visual novel, uncovering dark secrets in the Stygian Keep, the narrative weaves a compelling tale of self-discovery and mystery.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2748880/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
踏上《Grim's Gambit》的迷人旅程，这是一部精心制作的互动益智视觉小说，让你沉浸在我们的主角诺克斯的角色中。一个卷入破坏自然秩序的人物，现在因其涉嫌犯罪而接受审判。故事情节发生了大胆的转折，给诺克斯判处了一种既出乎意料又令人难以忘怀的奇异命运，为传统审判带来了独特的转折。诺克斯的惩罚在一家奇特的咖啡店的令人难以忘怀的氛围中展开，这家咖啡店坐落在荒凉的斯泰吉亚城堡之中。诺克斯因失忆症醒来，在整个游戏中逐渐拼凑出他被遗忘的过去。当玩家引导他完成解谜视觉小说，揭开斯泰吉亚城堡的黑暗秘密时，叙事编织了一个引人入胜的自我发现和神秘故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2748880/]Steam[/url]]
